name: Imrah
overview: Imrah was a male member of the tribe of Asher, identified specifically as the son of Zophah. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or detailed narrative provided. His lineage situates him within the genealogical records important to the history of Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Imrah means 'he rebels' in Hebrew. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 7:36, was not given directly by God but reflects a common Hebrew personal name of the period.
familyAndRelationships: Imrah is explicitly recorded as the son of Zophah, establishing his immediate paternal lineage. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide further family relationships for him.
scriptureSignificance: Imrah's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Asher, as noted in 1 Chronicles 7:36. While his personal story is not expanded upon, his inclusion underscores the biblical emphasis on tribal heritage and God's providential preservation of His people through their descendants.
